description: Calculate trip fuel quantity and cost from entered distance, fuel economy, fuel price and currency; supports US mpg, L/100 km and km/L. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

currency.description: Entered three-letter currency label (letters only), shared by all prices; no exchange rates.

distance.description: Nonnegative miles for us_mpg; kilometers otherwise.

economy.description: Positive US mpg, L/100 km or km/L as selected.

price.description: Entered price per US liquid gallon for us_mpg, per liter otherwise.

units.description: Unit system; Imperial mpg not accepted.

name: fuel_cost

outputSchema.description: Structured entered quantities, explicit unit labels, calculated results and formula; numeric arithmetic from entered values, with no inferred density, coverage or prices.

title: Fuel Cost Calculator
